decision: Do not reuse default WebGL canvas across frames without a defined preservation strategy. The observed preservation on this driver is not a portable API guarantee. No product cache was added.
constraint: WebGL Drawing Buffer specification states that source-image operations after rendering function return can have undefined behavior when preserveDrawingBuffer is false; true can cause significant performance loss on some platforms.
alternatives: preserveDrawingBuffer true requires measured moving-frame and memory-cost validation
Explicit RGBA framebuffer or image cache adds approximately 2 MiB at 1024 x 512, before driver overhead
